subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Malign
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Praise'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Malign" **means to say false and unpleasant things about someone or considerably harmful or evil.(कुटिल)
 
• The** correct antonym** or the opposite term for "Malign" from the provided options is **"Praise"**, which means to express approval or admiration for someone or something. (प्रशंसा)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: '**Praise'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Align: **This term means to place or arrange (things) in a straight line.(समायोजित करना)
 
• **Cheerful: **This term refers to being noticeably happy and optimistic.(खुश)
 
• **Harangue:** This term means a lengthy and aggressive speech.(भाषण)
